stage: Additional diagnostic specified after the support census, before tube-volume evaluation.
rule: Use five equal maximal paths, same two archived offset lobes. Center clocks at longest past interior height divided by (maximal interior height + 1), counted from 1; set isolated nodes at 1/2. Give each relative clock a symmetric box of half-width 1/64. Take continuous positive densities in a 1 percent symmetric band around each dwell prediction; masses 1/4, 1, 4. Check disjointness in W/D and bound the conditional probability under the original independent inner Hilbert-space field measure at any outer offset. This width is a diagnostic choice and supplies no P3 instrument or error allocation.
